description:
Frozen bundle of rule configurations for one session.

Stored verbatim inside `sessions.config_snapshot` (alongside the
persona, retention policy, etc.) so a replay can reconstitute the
rule set without re-reading the study row, which may have been
edited since.

rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by `rule.name`. Each value is a plain dict that the corresponding rule class parses into its own typed config. Missing entries mean 'use rule defaults'.
rules.title: Rules

rules_version.description: Stable identifier for the rule-set release this session uses (e.g. 'v1.0'). The registry refuses sessions whose version it does not know about.
rules_version.title: Rules Version

title: RulesConfig
